caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher rendered in pencil on a light, off-white background. The pitcher has a bulbous, rounded body and sits on a small circular base. Its surface is decorated with intricate relief designs, including swirling, leaf-like patterns and several raised corn cobs distributed around the body and near the top. The handle is elaborate, curving from the upper rim to the lower part of the pitcher with textured, carved details that resemble plant forms. The spout is wide and flared, with additional linear and curved embellishments. Shading throughout the drawing gives dimension to the pitcher and suggests a light source from the left, casting a soft shadow to the lower left of the object. The drawing is monochromatic, using various shades of graphite gray to create contrast and depth. In the bottom right corner, the name "Antino Louis" is written.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
